evidence.excluded_run: A 150-draw helper run keyed only by draw_no was excluded because draw numbers repeat across years.

balanced_default.rationale: Near-best archive hit performance while modestly increasing 6/49 jackpot-value exposure.

hit_frequency.rationale: Highest archive/recent 3+ frequency and mean best-hit among tested mixed allocations.

jackpot_tilt.rationale: More 6/49 exposure; highest archive 4+ rate among tested allocations, but lower 3+ frequency.

rejected_as_default.rationale: Largest jackpot-value tilt but materially weaker hit frequency and mean best-hit performance.

decision: Default ~€20 allocation: 8 lines 6/49 + 16 lines 6/42. Use 6+18 for hit-frequency priority and 14+9 only as an explicit jackpot tilt. Do not default to 16+6.
caveats: Lottery draws remain unpredictable; historical hit-rate differences do not imply future predictability.
Recent and official-payout samples are small and secondary to the 300-draw archive validation.
Jackpot EV ignores sharing with other jackpot winners.
Do not increase the precommitted budget in response to recent draws.
